# THUMBNAIL.md — Hearthlight (test fixture)

Thumbnail grammar for this channel. Language and boundaries, never a template.

## Visual grammar

Fire as the subject, warm and close. The frame glows; nothing competes with the flames.

## Typography

Optional single word in a warm serif.

## Text

Text optional; a duration or the word fireplace at most.

## Colour direction

Amber and deep shadow from the footage. No blue cast, no added glow.

## Subject emphasis

The fire in its hearth, from the film. No stock flame that is not in the video.

## Composition

Centred or slightly low hearth, flames filling the middle third.

## Acceptable layout families

Full-bleed frame. Full-bleed frame with one word.

## Avoid

Faces. Arrows. Fake flames. Cloned competitor framing.
